prompt: Create ONE polished, compact logo symbol for a Greek organic chemistry nomenclature learning game named 'Συνεργείο ονομάτων' (Name Repair Workshop), part of the Namelecule educational application. This request is for the SYMBOL ONLY; absolutely no lettering, words, numbers, initials, captions, watermark, or typography. Core idea: a recognizable open-ended mechanic's spanner / wrench, elegantly merged with a small ball-and-stick molecular motif. One sturdy diagonal spanner, open jaw at upper right, with its lower-left handle integrating three clearly separated circular atom-like nodes connected by short neat stems. The tool must be instantly recognizable as a workshop repair tool; chemistry motif should complement it, not turn into a random network or medical cross. Friendly, intelligent, professional educational identity; clean flat vector-like silhouettes, precise rounded curves, balanced negative space, strong legibility at small icon sizes. Restrained palette only: dark petrol teal #254c50, medium teal #397b78, pale mint #c4dfd4, and one small warm peach #f7dfcf accent. Deep teal should dominate for contrast. No photorealism, no metal texture, no 3D, no gradients, no drop shadows, no multiple variants, no badge mockup, no rectangular frame, no surrounding decorative clutter. Center a single coherent emblem with modest clear space; fill most of square canvas. Genuinely transparent background outside the symbol, suitable for placing on a warm cream webpage or white header. The connected circles are a symbolic branding motif, not a literal chemical structural formula.
